system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 40. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (33 seconds, code score 0.78) ---
[b00] LORD HARRINGTON (inquiring, subdued): "Of the wedding?"
[b01] LADY HARRINGTON (chilling, sarcastic): "And everything that comes after it."
[b02] BLOND NOBLEMAN (nervous, determined): "Everything must go perfectly."
[b03] ACTION: Rupert smooths the lapels of his coat, checking his posture as he waits for the bride.
[b04] ELDER NOBLEMAN (stern, scheming): "All entrances are covered?"
[b05] ROYAL GUARD (obedient, firm): "Every one, my Lord."
[b06] ELDER NOBLEMAN (calculating): "Good."
[b07] ELDER NOBLEMAN (ruthless, victorious): "By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess."
[b08] ELDER NOBLEMAN (deadly, uncompromising): "And its witch will be dead."

--- WINDOW 1 (27 seconds, code score 0.75) ---
[b00] LADY HARRINGTON (smug, impressed): "Look at them. Every noble family in the county is here today."
[b01] LORD HARRINGTON (ambitious, proud): "And soon, we'll be connected to the Duchess of Ashburgh."
[b02] LADY HARRINGTON (malicious, taunting): "Imagine Juliana seeing this."
[b03] LORD HARRINGTON (sinister, dismissive): "She won't be seeing anything for long."
[b04] LADY HARRINGTON (pleased, cold): "Good."
[b05] LORD HARRINGTON (chuckling, scornful): "This place has always been unlucky for Juliana."
[b06] ACTION: Lady Harrington lets out a soft, amused laugh as they reach the heavy wooden cathedral doors.
[b07] LADY HARRINGTON (vindictive, pious): "She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves."

--- WINDOW 2 (23 seconds, code score 0.70) ---
[b00] LORD HARRINGTON (chuckling, scornful): "This place has always been unlucky for Juliana."
[b01] ACTION: Lady Harrington lets out a soft, amused laugh as they reach the heavy wooden cathedral doors.
[b02] LADY HARRINGTON (vindictive, pious): "She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves."
[b03] ACTION: Lord and Lady Harrington slide gracefully into the polished wooden pew, smoothing their garments.
[b04] LADY HARRINGTON (anticipatory, eager): "We have an excellent view."
[b05] LORD HARRINGTON (inquiring, subdued): "Of the wedding?"
[b06] LADY HARRINGTON (chilling, sarcastic): "And everything that comes after it."
[b07] BLOND NOBLEMAN (nervous, determined): "Everything must go perfectly."

--- WINDOW 3 (42 seconds, code score 0.61) ---
[b00] ELDER NOBLEMAN (calculating): "Good."
[b01] ELDER NOBLEMAN (ruthless, victorious): "By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess."
[b02] ELDER NOBLEMAN (deadly, uncompromising): "And its witch will be dead."
[b03] SFX: The heavy creak of massive wooden cathedral doors swinging open, accompanied by swelling bridal organ music.
[b04] LADY HARRINGTON (awestruck, whispering): "She looks like a queen."
[b05] BLOND NOBLEMAN (enamored, flattering): "You look more queen than bride."
[b06] CATHERINE (smug, coquettish): "And you look better in silk than you ever did as an ignored cousin."
[b07] ACTION: Rupert and Catherine exchange conspiratorial, triumphant smiles at the altar as the solemn organ chord holds and the scene cuts to black.

Pick the single best promo.
